children: OpenAI said on X that a recent red-team exercise uncovered an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability in Brotli, a widely used compression library built into software including Node.js, Bun and Envoy. According to ChainCatcher, attackers could use malicious compressed data to take over unpatched servers, while malicious servers could compromise clients that accept compressed data.

OpenAI said the underlying issue was fixed in Brotli’s source code in February this year, but was not then identified as a security vulnerability, so software embedding the library also needs to be updated. The flaw is tracked as CVE-2026-111497, and Node.js released a patched version on October 21.

title: OpenAI Finds Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution Vulnerability in Brotli During Red-Team Testing
